#!/bin/bash

# Load environment variables from the docker_config.env file
if [ -f /workspace/docker_config.env ]; then
    export $(cat /workspace/docker_config.env | xargs)
fi

# Docker cleanup script

# Set cleanup scope and filters based on environment variables
# Example usage of environment variables:
# Assuming the following variables are defined in docker_config.env:
# - DOCKER_IMAGE_FILTER
# - DOCKER_CONTAINER_FILTER

# Cleanup unused images
if [ ! -z "$DOCKER_IMAGE_FILTER" ]; then
    echo "Cleaning up images with filter: $DOCKER_IMAGE_FILTER"
    docker rmi $(docker images -q --filter "reference=$DOCKER_IMAGE_FILTER")
fi

# Cleanup stopped containers
if [ ! -z "$DOCKER_CONTAINER_FILTER" ]; then
    echo "Cleaning up containers with filter: $DOCKER_CONTAINER_FILTER"
    docker rm $(docker ps -aq --filter "name=$DOCKER_CONTAINER_FILTER")
fi

# Additional cleanup commands can be added here

echo "Docker cleanup completed."
